PAK tablets are green, round, film-coated tablets engraved with LP-1 on one side. Each tablet contains 100 mg of doxycycline (equivalent to 115 mg doxycycline hyclate). Tablets containing 100 mg of doxycycline as doxycycline hyclate ( 3 )
